question: Simplify: 1800 ÷ 10 × {45 ÷ (17 - 2)} × 2 + {- 2(1 + 2)}
solution:
**Given:**

1800 div 10 times {45 div (17 - 2)} times 2 + {- 2(1 + 2)}

**Formula used:**

BODMAS Rule

**Calculation:**

1800 div 10 times {45 div (17 - 2)} times 2 + {- 2(1 + 2)}

⇒ 1800 div 10 times {45 div 15} times 2 + {- 2 times 3}

⇒ 180 times 3 times 2 - 6

⇒ 540 times 2 - 6

⇒ 1080 - 6

⇒ 1074

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
